description.value: Select Liquor Store is an independent liquor retailer in Port Coquitlam that has been serving customers since 2002. The shop carries an extensive selection of beer, wine, cider, cocktails, and spirits, and staff will attempt to source specific products on request. Online ordering with curbside pickup is also available for customers who prefer a quick stop.

address.value: 1760 Kingsway Avenue, Port Coquitlam, BC V3C1S5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at selectliquor.ca is live and provides corroborating address ('1760 Kingsway Avenue, Port Coquitlam') and a phone number not present in OSM.
